people.name: Ephraim
people.line: Second son of Joseph, and a tribe of Israel.

people.name: Kohath
people.line: Son of Levi; Levite clan ancestor

people.name: Levi
people.line: Son of Jacob; progenitor of the Levites

translations.web: The families of the children of Kohath, the Levites, even the rest of the children of Kohath, had the cities of their lot out of the tribe of Ephraim.
translations.bsb: The remaining Kohathite clans of the Levites were allotted these cities: From the tribe of Ephraim
translations.kjv: And the families of the children of Kohath, the Levites which remained of the children of Kohath, even they had the cities of their lot out of the tribe of Ephraim.
translations.asv: And the families of the children of Kohath, the Levites, even the rest of the children of Kohath, they had the cities of their lot out of the tribe of Ephraim.
